notes.title: Big content update!
notes.content:
UPDATE! Patch 0.6.0.0
Watch our update trailer!

[previewyoutube=M5nDMKGRd8w;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone,
We’re here to announce another milestone in our development of MonsterSoft.
Here’s what’s new…
- 3 new missions
- New playable character
- Humans can now use barricades and boosters
- Turrets as a new defensive system
- Armor as a way of reducing physical damage
- Skin for phone

Thank you for playing! If you find any bugs, mistakes, or oddities - PLEASE let us know here on
Steam, or on our official Discord (link below).
The best way is to record your gameplay or take screenshots of encountered unwanted
circumstances and filthy bugs :)

Join our channels:

New content and updates will come sooner than later...
Stay tuned.

notes.title: Update 0.5.5.0
notes.content:
At the start, I would like to say that for the last few months we worked hard on new content and we are getting really close to release it soon! But before that, we would like to fix all kinds of bugs we found and add some game improvements. Here is a whole list of changes:

Bug fix:
- Vampire Suck Blood won't add energy when it was canceled
- Vampire Hypnosis will calculate the distance to target in the correct way
- Vampire Blood Localization won't block environmental skills anymore
- Retrospection mode will display progression
- Zombie Instinct will display its status correctly after the character switch
- Visualization of a padlock on closed doors won't disappear
- Enemy presentation will appear even in a situation when the enemy hides during the presentation
- Empty inventory slot won't be highlighted after crafting
- Fixed situation when during the first room inspection you were able to see hidden characters
- Monsters and humans won't step on each other when they occupy the same field
- Alien Teleportation can be used from the game start
- Alien Abduction will deal 2 Sanity dmg as intended and the health bar will be presented
- Spiders in Haunted House will now always scare people
- Interrupted enemy attack won't enlonger enemy round phase
- Fixed the situation when after loading game from checkpoint negative effects were applied two times
- In multiplayer all toilets can be searched
- Events in multiplayer will be repeated if all the events occurred

Improvements:
- New sound for all lock puzzles
- Seamless transition from Demo version to Full Version
- Interaction option will have a hover animation
- Humans will react to dead bodies of other characters
- Video and audio settings

Game balance:
- Guillotine in Haunted House will now deal 2 Sanity points instead of 1
- Ghost PTSD will cost 1 energy instead of 2

notes.title: Update 0.5.2.20
notes.content:
We decided to change the distribution system. Previously to experience the Single Player mode you had to acquire a DLC pack (MonsterSoft - Campaign). From now on, the base game includes the Single Player Campaign already.

Steam support ensured us that this change won't affect current users. But if you bought a DLC and you have any problems with access the game after this change - let us know, fastest way is always our Discord:
https://discord.gg/jxm5Zqu

Moreover a few little changes:
[CHANGED] Way of reading notes is now more user-friendly
[CHANGED] Blocked possibility to start the multiplayer if where is no one else in the room
[ADDED] New SFX when breaking cameras

notes.title: Update 0.5.2.19
notes.content:
We focused on overall polish and game quality improvements. Also, we get rid of a few reported bugs.
Full list of changes:

[FIXED] Save/Load in Task #1 makes Tombstone disappear
[FIXED] In Task #2 usage of Bloody Portrait or Flamethrower Head sometimes freeze the camera
[FIXED] In Task #2 Ghost was able to exit Haunted House
[FIXED] In Task #2 Vampire could be noticed by humans even when she stood in the shadow in Attic Room

[CHANGED] In Tutorial we added info about Objectives display bound to Tab button
[CHANGED] In Tutorial new highlight system for easier searching for required items
[CHANGED] Unified UI display of character info
[CHANGED] Some misspell text errors.
[CHANGED] Binary code can be copied
